title: Certificate required.
officialText:
It shall be unlawful to perform the duties and responsibilities of a site safety coordinator as specified in chapter 33 of the New York city building code unless such work is performed by a person certified as a site safety coordinator under the provisions of this article and department rules.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
